We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

The Opportunity
We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our product engineering organization. In this role, you will help design, build, and scale features across our unified platform—from highly responsive React user interfaces down to core data processing backends built on Java and Python.This role is exceptional for an engineer looking to combine traditional full-stack development with cutting-edge AI-native engineering, specifically working with custom instrumentation agents and the emerging Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem.
What You'll Do
● End-to-End Ownership: Feature delivery from UI wireframes to backend
implementation, database migrations, and production deployments.
● UI/UX Development: Build, maintain, and optimize elegant, data-dense web
experiences and custom charts/dashboards using React, JavaScript, and HTML.
● Scalable Backend Services: Write high-quality, production-ready backend logic utilizing
Java (Spring Boot) and Python for processing heavy telemetry workloads.
● Database Management: Model data for high-throughput, low-latency systems across
structured SQL and unstructured NoSQL databases.
● DevOps & Observability Culture: Actively leverage New Relic’s own platform to
monitor app health, troubleshoot production latency, and improve system reliability.
This Role Requires
● Experience: 3 + years of professional software engineering experience in a
collaborative, agile team environment.
● Front End Craftsmanship: Strong proficiency in React, vanilla JavaScript, and
HTML. Solid understanding of state management and modern CSS.
● Backend Skills: Deep hands-on experience in Java (JVM tuning and microservices
framework experience preferred) combined with professional exposure to Python for
scripts, data pipelines, or web services.
● Database Proficiency: Solid understanding of data modeling, schema design, and
query optimization (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or Redis).
● Software Hygiene: Strong mastery of Git workflows, unit/integration testing (e.g., JUnit,
Jest, PyTest), and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
Bonus Points (Added Advantages)
● Telemetry & Agent Development: Experience writing or customizing monitoring
agents, eBPF probes, or open-source collection daemons (like OpenTelemetry).
● AI Tools & MCP Servers: Experience developing or connecting to Model Context
Protocol (MCP) servers, creating developer tools, or designing custom AI agent
integrations to enhance engineering productivity.
● Distributed Systems: Familiarity with high-throughput messaging structures like
Apache Kafka or AWS Kinesis.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the Organization 

Payments is at the core of Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We are expanding our payments footprint in India and we are looking for Backend Engineers to own the technical architecture behind our next generation of payment offerings in India. 

As part of the India Payments team, you will build on top of Stripe’s robust foundational platforms, driving complex integrations and contributing to the architectural evolution of the critical services that handle money movement every millisecond. You will engineer the entire horizontal payments stack, driving every phase of a transaction's journey: integrating with local payment rails, managing initiation and intelligent routing, ensuring reliable completion and automating reconciliation and payouts. 

Partnering with cross-functional engineering hubs globally, you will tackle high-stakes technical challenges requiring low-latency execution, strict transactional idempotency, zero-downtime migrations and resilient distributed state management at scale.

If you thrive on taking ambiguous product mandates and turning them into fault-tolerant, self-healing distributed systems, you will feel right at home here.

What You’ll Do (Core Responsibilities)

  • Architect and operate low-latency, fault-tolerant backend microservices that integrate with Indian payment methods
  • Map complex, India-specific payment flows into Stripe’s global, unified API platforms, ensuring a seamless integration experience for developers worldwide
  • Design highly reliable adapter layers that interact with domestic banking partners and payment networks, building systems that gracefully handle external API latency and asynchronous callbacks
  • Own end-to-end service health, implementing shadow rollouts, distributed tracing, automated failovers and proactive alerting for 99.99% uptime
  • Collaborate with Product, Regulatory/Legal, Risk and Partner Integration teams across global engineering hubs while delivering seamless developer-facing APIs
  • Mentor and empower engineers to contribute independently through ongoing technical guidance and actionable feedback

Other Responsibilities

  • Independently scope, build and ship medium-to-large projects from ambiguous requirements to production
  • Build robust APIs that hide the extreme complexity of Indian payment rails behind simple, elegant developer experiences
  • Partner with product and data teams to proactively identify, size and solve the most impactful problems for our users
  • Engineer highly reliable, scalable infrastructure that consistently meets strict SLAs for all internal and external systems
  • Debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack with an eye towards improving maintainability over the long term
  • Improve engineering standards, tooling and processes
  • Accelerate team velocity through high-quality code reviews and architectural collaboration

Who you are

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of experience designing, implementing and operating large-scale, high-performance APIs and services
  • You have implemented server-side APIs in languages like Ruby, Java, or Go, working with document and relational datastores (especially Mongo and MySQL)
  • Empathetic, collaborative and user-first mindset in everything you build and have excellent oral and written communication
  • Experience proactively seeking feedback from users, teammates and subject matter experts
  • The ability to balance speed, complexity, and scope in service of user needs
  • Excellent oral and written communication

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building large-scale financial systems, payments infrastructure or working in the broader fintech industry is a plus
  • Experience building distributed systems or operating within a complex microservices architecture
  • Proficiency in Ruby, Java, or Go, with deep experience modeling data in relational and document databases (e.g., MySQL, Mongo)
  • Experience driving technical alignment across global, cross-functional teams

 

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data. 

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The impact you will have:

  • Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration
  • Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer
  • Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.
  • Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.
  • Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.
  • Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.
  • Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.
  • Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What we look for:

  • 9+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering
  • Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks
  • Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one
  • Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments
  • Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs
  • Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.
  • Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.
  • Documentation and white-boarding skills.
  • Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range
  • Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.
  • Travel to customers 20% of the time
  • Databricks Certification

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. Intermediate Backend Engineer, Security Factory: Code Security

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Security team, you'll help developers find and fix security issues in the code they write and the open source components they depend on.

Your work connects dependency analysis, vulnerability detection, and automated remediation. You'll build parsing that tells the security analysis engine which libraries and frameworks a project uses, extend a service that turns security advisories into dependency update merge requests, and develop hybrid analyzers that combine rule-based detection with artificial intelligence (AI) reasoning. You'll help evaluate how well those analyzers find real vulnerabilities and expand coverage of libraries, frameworks, and AI agent tooling.

We use AI-assisted development tools in our daily work and expect you to use them effectively and with good judgment.

What you’ll do

  • Develop secure, well-tested, performant parsing for dependency manifests, lockfiles, and software bills of materials (SBOMs). Extend support for new package ecosystems and formats in the analysis engine and remediation service.
  • Build and apply analyzers that combine deterministic analysis with AI-driven analysis, working with the team's technical leadership. Review their results and measure false positives and missed findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities.
  • Create detection rules mapped to Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and the test fixtures that prove they work.
  • Contribute to packaging analyzers for continuous integration (CI) jobs, AI agent workflows, and command-line tools, reporting findings in GitLab's standard security report formats.
  • Extend the automated remediation service, from running dependency updates in a sandbox to opening merge requests.
  • Solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity. Identify technical debt that slows the team down, and propose and implement improvements.
  • Write maintainable code that meets our internal standards, and help maintain those standards through code review.
  • Participate in on-call rotations to troubleshoot product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience using AI or large language model (LLM) tools to generate or evaluate technical content, with the judgment to know when output is trustworthy and when it isn't.
  • Solid professional experience writing and testing production code in a systems language, particularly Go and/or Rust. We use both, plus Ruby for remediation and Python for some analyzers, and value a willingness to work across them.
  • A willingness to learn how vulnerabilities arise in code and the software supply chain, explore common vulnerability classes such as the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10 and CWE, and apply static analysis to detect them. Deep expertise isn't required, and we'll help you develop it.
  • The ability to organize your work and follow through on tasks independently in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.
  • The ability to communicate clearly and concisely about technical problems and propose iterative solutions.
  • Helpful, but not required: experience with containerized workflows and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), or a willingness to learn them; package managers and dependency tooling such as npm, Maven, pip, Bundler, or Cargo; web or mobile frameworks; parsing, abstract syntax trees (ASTs), program analysis, or detection rules; or evaluating AI-driven detection against labeled data. We use Docker heavily.

About the team

The Security Factory: Code Security team builds GitLab's code-level security scanning capabilities, spanning static application security testing (SAST) and dependency scanning.

We work closely with the Static Analysis team on GitLab's SAST engines, with Composition Analysis on the broader software supply chain, and with other groups across the Sec section. We rely heavily on asynchronous work across time zones.

 

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave
